note: Supply-chain pins for everything install.py fetches from the network. Hand-maintained: export.py reads this file and never rewrites it. Each repo is pinned to the commit that was default-branch HEAD on 2026-10-27 (resolved with `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/HEAD`). A pin means 'this exact content', not 'this content was code-reviewed'. heygen-com/hyperframes is pinned to 207c8a4 (2026-10-21), the last commit that still ships hyperframes-animation, -audio, -core, -creative and -keyframes; upstream HEAD (a669316) folded them into other skills, so a HEAD pin would silently drop five skills. To bump: resolve the new SHA, read the diff of the skills you use (nj-security-review), edit the line, commit.
